title: Berndt's generalized Hlawka inequality for positive definite matrices
statement:
For $n\geqslant 3$, let $A_1,\ldots,A_n$ be positive definite. For each $k=1,\dots,n$, define the **elementary symmetric determinantal polynomial**

$$
s_k:= \sum_{1 \leqslant i_1 < i_2 < \cdots < i_k \leqslant n} \det(A_{i_1} + \cdots + A_{i_k}).
$$

**Berndt's conjecture.** The following generalization of the Hlawka inequality holds:

$$
s_n + s_{n-2} + \cdots \geqslant s_{n-1} + s_{n-3} + \cdots.
$$

This conjecture generalizes the classical Hlawka inequality and was the original motivation for the paper. The supplied source does not indicate whether it has been resolved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1411.0065

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2014).
source_name: Wolfgang Berndt and Suvrit Sra, “Hlawka-Popoviciu inequalities on positive definite tensors”, arXiv:1411.0065 (2014).
